Description: UUse Permit Modification #ZP2024-0154 proposes to modify a previously approved Use Permit Modification (#ZP2015-0109), which permitted the conversion of a billiard room into a full-service restaurant and bar with an outdoor seating area and live entertainment. The proposed modification would convert approximately 1,086 square feet of mezzanine space from a storage area into circulation and a customer dining area, adding seating and tables for 20 patrons.
